First TeamSerie A EniliveSeason 2026/27Atalanta/Frosinone [...] Atalanta and Frosinone share a relatively recent history, having met just eight times in competitive action, fewer than against any other team in the current 2026/27 Serie A line-up. The fixture first entered the Nerazzurri record books in September 2010, with an inaugural meeting in Serie B, before the two sides went on to cross paths exclusively in the top flight. [...] A Sunday at home, in the middle of a week spent on the road. Fresh from their European trip to Amsterdam and with Florence already next on the horizon, Atalanta will make a stop at the New Balance Arena on 25 October to switch their focus back to Serie A, with Bergamo providing the one constant in a week moving between European and domestic action.
